Meeting Notes: Project Kickoff — Atlas Launch
Date: September 20, 2026 | Attendees: R. Chen (PM), S. Patel (Eng Lead), M. Osei (Design), J. Kowalski
(Marketing)
Overview
This meeting kicked off the Atlas Launch project, a new customer-facing dashboard for enterprise
accounts. R. Chen presented the initial project charter and timeline.
Roles & Ownership
S. Patel will lead engineering and own the technical architecture decisions. M. Osei will lead design and be

responsible for the UI/UX prototypes. J. Kowalski will own go-to-market planning and customer
communications.
Budget
The initial budget approved for Q3 was $180,000, covering engineering contractor costs, design tooling
licenses, and a small marketing pilot spend. R. Chen noted this figure would be revisited once the
engineering estimate was finalized.
Timeline
Target launch date discussed was November 15, 2026. S. Patel flagged this as ambitious given the

current team size and asked for a buffer to be considered in future planning.
Action Items
S. Patel: draft technical architecture doc by Sept 27. M. Osei: deliver first UI wireframes by Oct 3. J.
Kowalski: prepare a customer messaging outline by Oct 5.

Meeting Notes: Sprint Planning — Atlas Launch
Date: October 1, 2026 | Attendees: R. Chen (PM), S. Patel (Eng Lead), T. Nguyen (Eng), M. Osei
(Design)
Overview
Team reviewed the architecture doc submitted by S. Patel and broke down work into two-week sprints. T.
Nguyen joined the engineering team this week as a backend developer.
Budget Update
S. Patel presented a revised engineering estimate. Given the added backend complexity for multi-tenant

data isolation, the Q3 budget was increased from $180,000 to $210,000, approved by R. Chen pending
finance sign-off.
Sprint Plan
Sprint 1 (Oct 1–14): core dashboard layout, authentication flow. Sprint 2 (Oct 15–28): data visualization
widgets, API integration. Sprint 3 (Oct 29–Nov 11): polish, QA, and launch readiness review.
Risks
S. Patel raised a concern that the November 15 launch date is at risk if QA surfaces major issues during

Sprint 3, since there is currently no buffer built into the schedule.
Action Items
T. Nguyen: set up CI/CD pipeline by Oct 8. M. Osei: finalize wireframes into high-fidelity mockups by Oct
10. R. Chen: confirm budget increase with finance by Oct 7.

Meeting Notes: Client Check-in Call — Atlas Launch
Date: October 8, 2026 | Attendees: R. Chen (PM), J. Kowalski (Marketing), client: D. Alvarez (Northwind
Corp)
Overview
Check-in call with Northwind Corp, the pilot enterprise customer for the Atlas dashboard. D. Alvarez
shared feedback on the wireframes shared last week and raised a scheduling concern.
Client Feedback
D. Alvarez liked the proposed data visualization widgets but requested an additional export-to-CSV

feature, which was not in the original scope. J. Kowalski agreed to log this as a fast-follow request rather
than adding it to the current sprint.
Timeline Change
Due to the added QA buffer S. Patel requested in the Oct 1 sprint planning meeting, and to accommodate
the client's own internal rollout schedule, the launch date was moved from November 15 to November
22, 2026. D. Alvarez confirmed this works well for Northwind's side.
Action Items

Action Items
J. Kowalski: update the customer-facing timeline and messaging outline to reflect Nov 22. R. Chen: notify
the engineering team of the one-week schedule shift. J. Kowalski: log CSV export request as a post-launch
fast-follow item.

Reference Doc: Atlas Dashboard — Product Overview
& FAQ
Last updated: September 25, 2026 | Owner: M. Osei (Design)
What is Atlas?
Atlas is a customer-facing analytics dashboard built for enterprise accounts. It provides real-time usage
metrics, custom report widgets, and role-based access control for account admins.
Core Features
Real-time usage dashboard with configurable widgets. Role-based access (Admin, Editor, Viewer). Single

sign-on (SSO) support for enterprise identity providers. Multi-tenant data isolation so each customer's data
is fully separated.
Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Which browsers are supported? A: Atlas supports the latest two versions of Chrome, Edge, and
Firefox.
Q: Is there a mobile app? A: Not at launch. A mobile-responsive web view is planned, but a native mobile
app is not currently on the roadmap.

app is not currently on the roadmap.
Q: How is data refreshed? A: Dashboard metrics refresh every 15 minutes; a real-time streaming option
is being evaluated for a future release.
